caption: A broom is stood upright on the end of its handle in the middle of a kitchen floor and let go; it stays for a moment, leans more and more, and falls to the floor.

sa.check: A broom is stood upright on the end of its handle on a kitchen floor.
The release comes first, then the lean, then the fall.

pc.expect: The lean grows faster once it starts and the broom falls in the direction it leaned.
pc.fail: It stands indefinitely; or rights itself; or falls opposite to its lean.

pc.expect: Nothing pushes it, and it falls only after leaning.
pc.fail: It falls before leaning; or is pushed; or slides across the floor.

pc.expect: It pivots about the end of the handle.
pc.fail: The handle end slides far; or it floats up; or it spins.
It bends; or bounces; or melts.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The broom and the kitchen stay the same.
pc.fail: The broom changes colour; or the floor changes; or the kitchen rearranges.
